--- title: "Hands-on_Ex03" author: "Huang Zhanyi" date: "April 30, 2026" date-modified: "last-modified" execute: eval: true echo: true warning: false freeze: true --- ## Loading Required Libraries ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(ggiraph, plotly, patchwork, DT, tidyverse) ``` ::: ## Importing data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} exam_data <- read_csv("/Users/zhanyi/Desktop/M Y1S2/ISSS608/ISSS608-VAA/project 1/ISSS608/Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex03/data/Exam_data.csv") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} exam_data$MATHS <- as.numeric(exam_data$MATHS) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} exam_data$ENGLISH <- as.numeric(exam_data$ENGLISH) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} exam_data$SCIENCE <- as.numeric(exam_data$SCIENCE) ``` ::: ## Tooltip effect with tooltip aesthetic ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(ggiraph) library(ggplot2) p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(tooltip = NAME), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6*0.618 ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Interactivity ### Displaying multiple information on tooltip ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tooltip_css <- "background-color:white; #<< font-style:bold; color:black;" #<< p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(tooltip = NAME), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6*0.618, options = list( #<< opts_tooltip( #<< css = tooltip_css)) #<< ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Displaying statistics on tooltip ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tooltip <- function(y, ymax, accuracy = .01) { mean <- scales::number(y, accuracy = accuracy) sem <- scales::number(ymax - y, accuracy = accuracy) paste("Mean maths scores:", mean, "+/-", sem) } gg_point <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = RACE), ) + stat_summary(aes(y = MATHS, tooltip = after_stat( tooltip(y, ymax))), fun.data = "mean_se", geom = GeomInteractiveCol, fill = "light blue" ) + stat_summary(aes(y = MATHS), fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, size = 0.2 ) girafe(ggobj = gg_point, width_svg = 8, height_svg = 8*0.618) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Hover effect with data_id aesthetic ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(data_id = CLASS), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6*0.618 ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Styling hover effect ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(data_id = CLASS), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6*0.618, options = list( opts_hover(css = "fill: #202020;"), opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.2;") ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Combining tooltip and hover effect ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(tooltip = CLASS, data_id = CLASS), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6*0.618, options = list( opts_hover(css = "fill: #202020;"), opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.2;") ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Click effect with onclick ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} exam_data$onclick <- sprintf("window.open("%s%s")", "https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder?journey=Primary%20school", as.character(exam_data$NAME)) p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(onclick = onclick), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe( ggobj = p, width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6*0.618) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Coordinated Multiple Views with ggiraph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p1 <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(data_id = NAME), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,100)) + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) p2 <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = ENGLISH)) + geom_dotplot_interactive( aes(data_id = NAME), stackgroups = TRUE, binwidth = 1, method = "histodot") + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,100)) + scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) girafe(code = print(p1 + p2), width_svg = 6, height_svg = 3, options = list( opts_hover(css = "fill: #202020;"), opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.2;") ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Interactive Data Visualisation - plotly methods! ### Creating an interactive scatter plot: plot_ly() method ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_ly(data = exam_data, x = ~MATHS, y = ~ENGLISH) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Working with visual variable: plot_ly() method ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_ly(data = exam_data, x = ~ENGLISH, y = ~MATHS, color = ~RACE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Creating an interactive scatter plot: ggplotly() method ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p <- ggplot(data=exam_data, aes(x = MATHS, y = ENGLISH)) + geom_point(size=1) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,100), ylim=c(0,100)) ggplotly(p) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Coordinated Multiple Views with plotly ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d <- highlight_key(exam_data) p1 <- ggplot(data=d, aes(x = MATHS, y = ENGLISH)) + geom_point(size=1) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,100), ylim=c(0,100)) p2 <- ggplot(data=d, aes(x = MATHS, y = SCIENCE)) + geom_point(size=1) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,100), ylim=c(0,100)) subplot(ggplotly(p1), ggplotly(p2)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Interactive Data Visualisation - crosstalk methods! ### Interactive Data Table: DT package ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} DT::datatable(exam_data, class= "compact") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Linked brushing: crosstalk method ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d <- highlight_key(exam_data) p <- ggplot(d, aes(ENGLISH, MATHS)) + geom_point(size=1) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,100), ylim=c(0,100)) gg <- highlight(ggplotly(p), "plotly_selected") crosstalk::bscols(gg, DT::datatable(d), widths = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: :::
